discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Topological insulators are a long-standing frontrunner in condensed matter. They follow on from the 2016 prize for topological phases. The Kane-Mele theory (2005) and Molenkamp's HgTe quantum-well experiment (2007) are the founding theory-plus-experiment pair. These laureates already hold the Breakthrough, Dirac and Oliver Buckley prizes. Since Shoucheng Zhang has died, these three are the natural trio.
